execution.cacheScope: Standalone filtered process;256MiB soft free-cache policy set and peak reset before model initialization. No parent-process cache restoration is claimed.
execution.timingScope: Includes diagnostics, readback and file work; not a throughput measurement or comparison.

finding: For this pair, jointly advancing the captured noise and incoming history reproduces actual frame46 exactly while base45 guides stay fixed; each single intervention differs. The effects are nonadditive.

independentAudit.baselineActualBytesScope: Actual matching outputs were compared/read by the harness; only prior matching references and any actual failures are retained for this independent audit.

numericReductionTolerance.scope: Float64 reduction-order reconciliation only, not image/quality tolerance

interactionDefinition: E(noise46,history46)-E(noise46,history45)-E(noise45,history46)+E(noise45,history45), component nits; describes nonadditivity of this matrix only.
limitations: The baseline harness saves every mismatch but does not save every matching reproduced frame. Successful baseline actual hashes/finite status are reported observations, cross-checked against independently verified prior bytes.

The four interventions fix frame45 color/motion/confidence/depth/proxy while selecting captured noise/incoming history. Actual frame46 is compared separately; fixed guides are not silently assumed to equal frame46.
Noise/history interaction is descriptive algebra for this fixed-input four-case matrix, not an identified production defect or sole cause of natural temporal variation.
Reported state equality covers the dumped temporal state, lifecycle description and guide/index tensors; it is not a global allocator/driver-state proof.
No perceptual acceptance, ghost-free, physical HDR/A/V, native playback or throughput qualification follows.
These controls concern frames45/46 only; they do not explain moving-frame extrema or all temporal behaviour.
The natural noise schedule and history policy are unchanged. Fixed noise or reset tuning is not proposed by this result.
The fixture and model files must be supplied separately; this evidence does not publish model weights or raw tensor payloads.

measuredState.controls: Base45 colour, motion, confidence, depth and full-resolution proxy remain fixed. No control mask is present.
measuredState.stateEqualityScope: Incoming history, cached extension indices, native guides, lifecycle description, noise index and composition options; no global allocator/driver-state claim.

metricScope: Equal-weight RGB component nits only for full linear HDR outputs. Intermediate units are their native tensor domains; no luminance weighting or perceptual threshold.
scope: One M3 replay of a retained synthetic static-frame pair; no production policy change.
subtractionDirection: Named actual case minus named reference; all full HDR comparisons use equally weighted RGB components.
